title: Extend GraphQL: Add Your Own Types and Queries | Orchard Core
description:
The GraphQL schema of Orchard Core is built from the services that modules register, so a content part, a filter or a query of your own is missing from it until you add it.

This video follows the code that Orchard Core's own modules use: an object type for a content part, an input type and an index for filtering, an ISchemaBuilder for a query of your own, and a GraphQLFilter for the content type queries. Each result is checked in GraphiQL.

In this video:
• How the schema is built from registered services
• Exposing a content part with an object type
• Checking the part in GraphiQL
• Filtering by the part with an input type and an index
• Trying the filter in the where argument
• Adding a query of your own with an ISchemaBuilder
• Running the query in GraphiQL
• Changing the content type queries with a GraphQLFilter
• Working examples in the Orchard Core source
